stepExplanation: The turning point form of a parabola is y = a(x - p)^2 + q, where (p, q) is the turning point. With turning point (2, -3), we get y = a(x - 2)^2 + (-3) = a(x - 2)^2 - 3.
stepTitle: Write the equation in turning point form
stepBody: Using the turning point form y = a(x - p)^2 + q with turning point (2, -3), write the equation with the unknown constant a.
